title: Heroes Tactics War
description: Assemble fantasy legions of paladins, griffins, and spellcasters—outflank enemy armies across classic hex-style tactical skirmishes.
controls: Arrange troop formations, tap skills and targets during combat, and upgrade your army between battles.

zh-CN.title: 英雄无敌战棋
zh-CN.description: 经典奇幻战棋策略英雄无敌：招募骑士、法师与传奇魔兽组建军团，运筹帷幄克敌制胜称霸魔幻大陆！
zh-CN.controls: 战前排兵布阵，战斗中释放英雄魔法与战术指令击溃敌军扩大领地。
